report_topic: Welfare of Building and Other Construction Workers
observations_summary: The audit revealed significant discrepancies in labour cess collection and remittance, with ₹18.12 crore in defective instruments and ₹12.09 crore untraced. It also found that ineligible beneficiaries were registered, and the Board faced issues in financial management and project implementation, spending ₹6,198.34 crore against a ₹10,154.45 crore budget.
